paragraphs.source_en: The EMP detonates. Sounds like a giant child gasping when pricked by a needle. Our electronics die. Our gravBoots sputter. StarShell synapses fail, causing the massive metal suits to be gripped by gravity. We plummet down. Most fall into the mud of the riverbank. I splash into the water. Sinking. Sinking. Ears popping. Down and down till I lodge into the mud of the river bottom. Hitting hard. Legs buckling under the weight of my starShell. Fall on my back. Can’t see my men. Only saw shapes moving over the surface of the water as I fell. Now too deep to see anything except how the river darkens with blood. Occasional lightning flashes silhouette fast-sinking bodies.

units.source_en: Sounds like a giant child gasping when pricked by a needle.

Legs buckling under the weight of my starShell.

paragraphs.source_en: I can’t move. My starShell is too heavy. I lie like a turtle, half stuck in mud at the bottom of the river. Confused. Fear rides in me. It happened so fast. Can’t even look to my left or my right to see who is with me. My com is dead. If it weren’t, I’d probably hear screams, curses.

units.source_en: I lie like a turtle, half stuck in mud at the bottom of the river.
Can’t even look to my left or my right to see who is with me.
If it weren’t, I’d probably hear screams, curses.

paragraphs.source_en: This starShell brought me from space to land. A life raft, a personal castle in the middle of a war. Now it’s my coffin.

units.source_en: This starShell brought me from space to land.
A life raft, a personal castle in the middle of a war.

paragraphs.source_en: Hyperventilating. Terror traps itself in my chest, tensing me, making me swallow the air, eating it as though it’ll give me power to move. Slow down. Slow down. Think. Think. Two bodies sink near me. Heavy in their armor, they fall fast to join the others on the bottom. No grace in death, spilling blood as they go. When the killers finish with those stuck in the mud of the riverbank, they’ll come for us down here. But they don’t need to. I slow my breathing. Limited oxygen left in the suit. Recycler offline.

Heavy in their armor, they fall fast to join the others on the bottom.
No grace in death, spilling blood as they go.
When the killers finish with those stuck in the mud of the riverbank, they’ll come for us down here.
Limited oxygen left in the suit.

paragraphs.source_en: Cassius knew my plan. It had to have been him. Or was I betrayed?

units.source_en: It had to have been him.

paragraphs.source_en: I told no one but the Sons and Sevro and Mustang. None of them could have ratted. He just knew. That bloody bastard. If I could surrender, I would. I’d save the lives of those with me. But I don’t have a com.

units.source_en: I told no one but the Sons and Sevro and Mustang.

ja.t: はサンズとセヴロとムスタング

units.source_en: None of them could have ratted.

ja.t: まみれのろくでなしめ。

units.source_en: If I could surrender, I would.
I’d save the lives of those with me.
But I don’t have a com.

paragraphs.source_en: I jerk my body around, trying to push myself off my back. But I’m too lodged in the mud, and my suit is more than one ton of metal. I can’t shed the weight. Can’t get the starShell off. I need the electronics for that. I push up with my arms. Nothing. The mud swallows me. Mustang got away. I think. I hope. Will she know we’re down here?
